newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong Kingswood Villa 78X subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong Kingswood Villa 78X subscribed.

text.p: Property developer and real estate group Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd said its Kingswood Villa residential development was 78 times subscribed.

Cheung Kong said in a statement late on Friday there were 3,742 potential buyers registered at the close of a four-day registration on Friday. About 92 percent were registered under their own name with eight percent under company names.
The flats, priced up from HK$4,089 a square foot, would be sold through ballot on March 30, it said.
The units opened for sale were in the final phase on the company's Kingswood Villa development in Tin Shui Wei in Hong Kong's New Territories, it said.
